@protobuf__rpc.summary: Protobuf / gRPC RPC mapping for fields or entity object types.

authors.intro: Pair with `@transport` for the gRPC endpoint.

implementers.loaders: Schemas that use `@protobuf__rpc` must `@link` this family and import the directive.
implementers.compose: May rewrite mapping binds under renames.
implementers.runtime: On resolve: encode request from `args` → send to `service`/`method` at `@transport(location:)` → decode response with `selection`. If `stream`, yield an AsyncIterable of decoded chunks. Transport/RPC failures become GraphQL field errors.
implementers.validation: Require `method` (and `service` for a real call). `stream: true` is invalid on unary-only HTTP transports. `subgraph`, when present, must match the composition subgraph name.

subgraph.constraints: A subgraph name string. When set, it must be the same identifier used for that source in composition — the same name as on `@transport(subgraph:)` and elsewhere for this subgraph. Do not invent a second name for the same source.
subgraph.authors: Name which composed subgraph owns this annotation. Use the same subgraph name you use everywhere else for that source. Omit when a single-source schema does not need attribution.
subgraph.implementers: Attribute the directive to that composition subgraph name. Use the same string as on `@transport(subgraph:)` and other directives for the source. Never invent a second name for the same source.

service.defaults: Optional in SDL; required for a real call.
service.implementers: Resolve the gRPC/Connect service path together with `method`. Required to place the call.

method.defaults: Optional in SDL; required for a real call.
method.implementers: RPC method name on the wire, combined with `service`.
method.validation: Must be a non-empty string for executable apps.

args.constraints: Compact GraphQL → protobuf request mapping with `$args` / `$this`.
args.authors: Describe how GraphQL arguments (and `$this` for entity roots) build the protobuf request.
args.implementers:
When it runs: Before the RPC is sent, when resolving the annotated field (or entity fill).

Input: GraphQL `args` (and parent/`$this` for entity-style roots) plus the parsed `args` mapping (`fieldId(type): $args…` / `$this…` with nested messages).

Output: Encoded protobuf request bytes for `service`/`method`.

Errors: Invalid mapping or unbound required fields fail the field with a GraphQL error; do not send a partial request.

selection.authors: Describe how each protobuf response field becomes a GraphQL value. Use nested blocks for messages and `repeated` for lists.
selection.implementers:
When it runs: After a successful RPC response (unary bytes, or each streamed chunk), before the GraphQL field value is returned.

Input: Wire response bytes from the RPC, plus the parsed `selection` mapping (`fieldId(type): graphqlBind` with nested `{ … }`; optional leading `@TypeName { … }` reusable defs).

Output: A GraphQL-shaped value: scalars/enums/messages projected into objects/lists per the mapping. Absent implicit-presence fields materialize wire defaults; explicit/`optional` fields stay unset when absent.

Errors: Malformed mapping text fails schema/resolver setup. Decode/wire errors become GraphQL field errors (do not return a partial object unless the mapping explicitly allows sparse binds).

stream.implementers: When true, use a server-streaming call and return an AsyncIterable of decoded messages (one `selection` decode per chunk). Unary HTTP transports must reject streaming.
stream.validation: If true, the transport must support server streaming; otherwise reject.

entity.constraints: True to register as Mesh entity resolver on Query fields / OBJECT apps.
entity.implementers: When true, treat the field/type as an entity/reference resolver: encode from the representation/`$this`, invoke the RPC, decode with `selection`, and return the entity object.
